title: The Ideal Sponger Life
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Overworked salaryman Zenjirou is summoned to another world by Queen Aura of Capua, who asks him to become her prince consort and give her an heir in exchange for a life of ease. He accepts, brings modern appliances from Japan, and is drawn into court politics as nobles and rival suitors scheme around the royal couple (Wikipedia; Manga Bookshelf; Seven Seas blurb via AniList).
life_message: A marriage begun for duty can grow into real love and partnership when both spouses support each other's roles.

content.note: Political intrigue, wyvern hunts and a general's ambitions (Wikipedia); no review mentions graphic violence.
Court scheming rather than danger (Manga Bookshelf).

folkways.japan: The 'himo' (kept man) of the title and escape from salaryman overwork are Japanese social types, treated with gentle humor.

delivery.evidence: Manga Bookshelf presents it as worldbuilding and politics without moralizing; Wikipedia notes ANN praised its handling of sensitive subject matter.

personified.ideology: a woman ruler keeping power in a patriarchal court

delivery.note: Rival nobles are drawn as capable schemers with their own aims rather than as fools, as far as summaries show.

winners_losers: Zenjirou and Aura build a loving marriage and secure the throne; ambitious rivals are held off. Sympathy goes to dynastic duty that turns into affection.
